item.title: 5 Years Later, a Dropout Star's Breakout Thriller Is Officially Free on Streaming
item.description: It's possible that you might associate the name Josh Ruben with the streaming service Dropout, or with one of Dropout's viral videos. For the last few years, Ruben has been one of the more reliable improv performers on shows like Make Some Noise and Game Changer , with a gift for celebrity impersonations and coming up with strange characters on the fly.

item.title: Logan Paul Just Proved His 'Pokémon' Haters Wrong
item.description: YouTuber Logan Paul has been accused of a lot of things: ruining the Pokémon trading card hobby, clickbait, greed, thoughtlessness. Maybe some of these condemnations are true. A recent revelation by the blonde provocateur has started to convince me that he may not, in fact, be a larper . Actually, I'm starting to believe the boisterous influencer might legitimately like Pokémon.

item.title: 20 Years Later, Rockstar’s Best Game Still Doesn’t Have the Sequel It Deserved
item.description: These days, Rockstar Games is one of the most famous developers in the world. That’s primarily thanks to their magnum opus, the Grand Theft Auto series, but also the Red Dead Redemption games, and to a lesser extent, L.A. Noire and the Max Payne series. In just a few short weeks, Grand Theft Auto 6 will finally be here, a game that has felt like a distant dream for so long, after delays and a slow trickle of new information. But 20 years ago, Rockstar released one of its most unique games that has hints of the classic GTA formula, and it's a crying shame that there is still no sign of a sequel.

item.title: Star Wars' Secret Writers Quietly Made the Strangest, Scariest Zombie Movies of All Time
item.description: Besides the occasional shadow person who creeps into my room once a fortnight, nothing paralyzes me quite like deciding what to watch on Oct. 31. In my mind, Halloween is a horror movie marathon month where veering in and out of subgenres and quality metrics is highly encouraged. So how do you close it out on actual Halloween?

item.title: 60 Years Later, the Best 'Peanuts' Quote of All Time Still Doesn't Get the Credit it Deserves
item.description: One of the best examples comes from a Feb. 3, 1966, comic strip in which Lucy mocks him for volunteering for a school spelling bee. Charlie Brown’s response contains some of the best advice Schulz ever put on the page. Sixty years later, it’s still something we can all stand to remember.

item.title: Nintendo’s Biggest Game of the Year Isn't What You Think It Is
item.description: This is the time of year when Nintendo's global marketing departments start limbering up and doing stretches for a big mass-market retail push. Nintendo UK launched a wholesome and emotive campaign this week, seemingly trying to one-up Nintendo Australia's legendary sad Zelda dad campaign for Tears of the Kingdom back in 2023. It doesn't quite work, but something about it caught my eye.

item.title: CBS's Legendary 156-Episode Sci-Fi Anthology Series is Officially Free to Watch on Streaming
item.description: In the realm of science fiction, Star Wars and Star Trek are generally considered to be the two biggest and most important franchises of all time. If you’re purely talking about profitability, that’s correct; those two have dominated TV and film for decades. However, if you factor in things like influence and impact, another sci-fi property ranks right up there with the big two. In the realm of sci-fi, pretty much all roads lead to, or derive from, The Twilight Zone . And this landmark show is currently free to stream.

item.title: 5 Must-Play New Xbox Games Coming in November, Including GTA 6
item.description: If you only took a quick glance at November’s release date calendar, you might walk away with the idea that Xbox players are only getting one game this month: Grand Theft Auto 6 . While that’s certainly the only big game coming to Series X, the first few weeks of November are deceptively crowded . A stack of indie hidden gems and nostalgic remasters are here to make sure you have something to play while you wait for your return to Vice City.

item.title: Sony's Bringing Back Spider-Man $2.5 Billion Hit With New Footage
item.description: As Marvel Studios' release of Avengers Endgame: Encore proves, blockbuster movies can still dominate the box office , even after a multibillion dollar run. Sony is reportedly planning a rerelease of Spider-Man: Brand New Day to bring web-head-heads back to movie theaters — and like Endgame: Encore , the studio is adding new footage of Spider-Man 's latest flick as an incentive.
